footnote_text: Pursuant to the Merger Agreement, at the Scheme effective time, each option to acquire ordinary shares under the Barinthus equity plans that was outstanding as of immediately prior to the Scheme effective time ceased to represent a right to acquire ordinary shares of Barinthus and was converted into an option to acquire shares of common stock of the Issuer and assumed by the Issuer on the same terms and conditions (including applicable vesting and exercisability conditions) as were applicable to such option immediately prior to the Scheme effective time. || Pursuant to the Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated September 29, 2025, by and among Clywedog Therapeutics Holdings, Inc. (formerly known as Beacon Topco, Inc.) (the "Issuer"), Barinthus Biotherapeutics plc ("Barinthus"), Cdog Merger Sub, Inc. and Clywedog Therapeutics, Inc. (as amended, the "Merger Agreement"), restricted share units ("RSUs") previously granted to the Reporting Person by Barinthus, vesting of which was subject to completion of the transactions contemplated by the Merger Agreement ("Merger Close"), and each of which represented the contingent right to receive one ordinary share of Barinthus, whether or not then vested, was automatically released in consideration of the assumption of such RSU by the Issuer and converted into an RSU for the common stock of the Issuer. The RSUs shall vest on November 27, 2026, the date which 7 days after the Merger Close.
